description.zh:
自动化响应类型。取值：
- event：事件
- alert：告警
description.en:
The type of automated response. Valid values:

- event: event

- alert: alert

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the Data Management center of threat analysis is deployed. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Assets in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).

- ap-southeast-1: Assets outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of the member.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The type of view. Valid values:

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that are managed by the administrator account.

title.zh: 获取自动化规则策略可配置字段及操作符

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem describe-automate-response-config-feature --auto-response-type event --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
